缺陷 A4 · P2 · 无障碍

多处文字对比度不达 AA（问卷按钮 3.66:1，Previous Notes 标题 2.5:1，dashboard 房号行等）

票：— · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地（视觉巡检）

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：OAT-06/S24a, TC-20/S18, TC-25/S21

思路 / Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S22 「Previous Notes 面板默认状态下的 axe（医院和养老院）」 axe on the Previous Notes panel in its default state (Hospital and Nursing Home)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Paste and photograph are physician-triggered only. Nothing is read, extracted or written to the chart until the physician pastes or photographs a prior note and saves it, and no prior note is pulled …（UAT TC-13；TFA-92591 AC 6；TFA-92591 How it works 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress

测试设计方法：无障碍（accessibility） — 按读屏、键盘、对比度、点按尺寸的规则（axe）查，残障用户也要能用。

Given Visual-lane fixture: Hospital and Nursing Home Pre-Round as visual-lane.ts loads them, with the Previous Notes panel empty

When Run axe on the Pre-Round tab

Then No WCAG 2 A/AA violations on the panel, and Paste and Photograph have accessible names

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：axe-core violations = 0 (visual-checks.ts) on the two screens. This covers the default state only. The Paste form, an expanded saved note and the photo error are in S28 and are not covered by this run

在哪跑：本地 visual lane（截图 + axe）；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（automated）

S22 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-13.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：无障碍 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92591 in progress

Previous Notes 标题和「0/3」计数对比度不够（2.5:1 和 4.34:1，低于 AA）；Paste 和 Photograph 按钮有名字。

The Previous Notes header and its '0/3' counter fall below the AA contrast minimum (2.5:1 and 4.34:1). Paste and Photograph do have accessible names.

依据：allure c9c65fc4, visual lane: 6 passed, 6 failed across desktop, iPhone 15 and Pixel 7. axe color-contrast fails on hospital-chart-preround and nh-chart-preround.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane visual。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：visual。
